faqs.q: How many Dried Blueberries should I eat daily?
faqs.a: A typical daily serving is 1 tablespoon (about 15g to 20g, or 15–20 berries) eaten as a snack or mixed into morning oats, yogurt, or trail mix.

faqs.q: Are these real whole blueberries or black currants/raisins?
faqs.a: They are 100% real whole blueberries (Vaccinium species) with their characteristic crown scar and deep indigo-purple anthocyanin skin—not black raisins.

faqs.q: Can I use Dried Blueberries in baking and porridge?
faqs.a: Yes! When simmered in warm oatmeal or baked into muffins, the dried berries plump up and release rich berry flavor.

faqs.q: How long does one 100 GM jar last?
